assets.title: IDENTITY-PROCESS.txt
assets.album: Design and outfit notes · Armor Swap
assets.text:
Hon Dolo identity transfer (locked process)
Ground truth face: HD-EXP-LOCK-FACE.jpg
Chest ship: SHIP-TATTOO-REF-05 + twin-tower schematic

Every scene/outfit swap:
1. KEEP from scene plate: clothes, wanted accessories (chain, armor, etc.), environment only
2. REPLACE from LOCK-FACE: face likeness, messy curls, brow slit (left), eye/know text, left-neck blaster,
   dual right-nostril silver hoops, dual bottom-lip silver rings, left ear hoop / right black stud,
   grill = two subtle gold K9s (slightly longer) + silver lower only
3. NEVER keep donor-face tattoos (Chewie, cheek ship, dice, monster, etc.)
4. Generate 5 → QA vs LOCK-FACE side-by-side → pick → tight regen

This is also saved in agent memory as the standing identity transfer process.

assets.text:
Round 2 — base plate SWAP-05 + LOCK-FACE + ship flash #5 + twin-tower schematic

Target fixes: grill (gold K9s only + silver lower), lock piercings/earrings, chest ship = twin-tower disc with speed lines

Honest read:
- R2-01: twin-tower chest closer; grill still full gold upper; eye/know may swap; piercings partial
- R2-02: gold K9s + silver lower visible; dual nose hoops; eye/know text drifted; chest more city/spires than flash #5
- R2-03: twin-tower chest good; piercings drifted (bridge/septum); wardrobe cutout drift
- R2-04: grill closest to lock (gold K9s + silver lower, dual lip rings); scene drifted to airliner cockpit/clouds; brow slits wrong side
- R2-05: best overall balance — dual nose hoops, gold K9s + silver lower, brow slit, harness/hyperspace held; chest still leans freighter vs twin-tower flash; earrings may be swapped

Pick a number + what to nail next (or “05 ship only”) and I’ll tight-pass that plate.

assets.title: QA-NOTES.txt
assets.album: Design and outfit notes · Cockpit Swap
assets.text:
Hon Dolo cockpit identity swap — 5 versions
Refs: HD-EXP-LOCK-FACE.jpg + REF-cockpit-source.jpg
Goal: keep jacket/harness/chair/thrusters/hyperspace; lock face/grill/tattoos/piercings

Common drifts vs LOCK-FACE (check before Comfy):
- Grill often solid gold upper instead of subtle dual gold K9s + silver lower
- Brow: slit sometimes replaced by piercings or a dark bar
- Neck blaster side/placement wanders (lock = left neck)
- Piercings: nose sometimes septum/single instead of dual right-nostril hoops
- 02: "eye" became Eye-of-Horus mark — weakest identity match

Pick a winner (or mix notes) and I’ll tight-regen that plate.

assets.text:
# Hon Dolo — Nova consolidation + conversational ID map
**Date:** 2026-10-07  
**For:** Nova (file re-org on D: / references)  
**Keep everything Ziggy said hang onto.** This doc only sorts **ACTIVE reference pool** vs **ARCHIVE / do-not-contaminate**.

Companion machine files in this folder:
- `HD-EXP-ID-TO-FILENAME.csv` — every numbered ID we can prove on the Grok box
- `HD-EXP-ID-TO-FILENAME.json` — same + missing-ID notes
- `UNMAPPED-HASH-FILES.json` — 159 hash-named stills with no proven EXP#

---

## 0. How download names broke the conversation numbers

| What Nova saw | What it means in chat |
|---|---|
| Folders like `hon-dolo-recent-263-277` / `… (1)` | Zip unpacks; `(1)` = browser duplicate of same zip |
| `HD-EXP-291-cantina-leather-front.jpg` | Chat shorthand **#291** |
| `HD-EXP-LOCK-FACE.jpg` | Chat **LOCK-FACE** (not an EXP number) |
| `ef5d59a6…jpg` (agent attachment stem) | **Same bytes as LOCK-FACE** (SHA-256 `ef5d59a6402eaff568e30bb6a4432b14b90c692ea6758a761c7702c44d457978`) |
| Hash filenames in `unmapped/` | Mid-range EXP stills whose # was never written onto the filename |
| Root MP4s + walk-pack MP4s | Exact copies of the same two clips |

**Rule:** Prefer `HD-EXP-NNN-*.jpg` / `HD-EXP-NNN.jpg` as the conversational ID. Ignore Windows `(1)` folder suffixes. Deduplicate by SHA, not by folder.

Nova’s measurement is correct: **LOCK-FACE ≠ #277 ≠ #289** (different bytes and pixels). The brief’s old “same pixels” claim for #289 was wrong; treat #289 as a **related soft polish**, not a clone.

---

## 1. Folder → role map (collapse 7+ folders into 4 logical buckets)

Ziggy keeps all files on disk. Nova should **re-home copies** (or symlink/index) into roles without deleting archives.

### A. `00_ACTIVE_POOL` — only these contaminate Comfy / IP-Adapter

| Put here | Source folder(s) | Files |
|---|---|---|
| Identity | `hon-dolo-lock-turnaround-outfits`, `hon-dolo-walk-pack`, `hon-dolo-stills-95-plus` | **`HD-EXP-LOCK-FACE.jpg` only** (one copy) |
| Soft polish (optional) | same | `#289` — label soft; not identity |
| Artwork map (fallback) | `hon-dolo-recent-263-277` | `#277` — no-dice map; LOCK-FACE wins on conflict |
| Finish refs | workspace REFs / 95-plus | `REF-184-finish-hoodie.jpg`, `REF-186-finish-fur.jpg`, `REF-95-denim-shearling.jpg` (+ named `#184` / `#186` if needed) |
| Neck blaster placement heritage | 95-plus | `#259` (and stencil sheets if compositing) |
| Turnaround scaffolds | `hon-dolo-lock-turnaround-outfits` | `#291–305` — wardrobe/angle only |
| Walk pose scaffolds | `hon-dolo-walk-pack` | **`#306–311` only** |
| Docs | `hon-dolo-nova-brief-through-314` | Journey through 314 + gap update (current). Older journey = history. |

### B. `01_ARCHIVE_HISTORY` — keep, do not feed as identity

| Source | Why archive |
|---|---|
| `hon-dolo-stills` / 01–50 + 51–95 zips | Early wardrobe exploration `#1–95` (gaps 74, 86–89 never generated) |
| `hon-dolo-stills-95-plus` named mid files | Dice/falcon/third-eye/Leigh-stack era (`#176`, `#193–247`, brow-dice `#261–266`, etc.) |
| `hon-dolo-recent-263-277` | Dice cleanup arc; rejected healed-ink `#272–276`; cheek-dice `#263` |
| `hon-dolo-outfit-run-278-282` | Outfit tests with known drift; **withdrawn as working base** |
| `hon-dolo-recent-263-277 (1)` | Exact image dupe of recent pack + older journey docs |
| Stencils: dice candidates / 195–262 dice | Dice **DROPPED** — archive only |
| Contact sheets / brow zooms / compare sheets | QA helpers, not masters |
| Walk clips (both copies) | Still-loop/morph demos only — not performance drivers |
| Walk `#312–314` | Drifted 3/4 poses |

### C. `02_QUARANTINE_DO_NOT_CONTAMINATE` — highest risk of poisoning the pool

These are the ones Ziggy likely does **not** want inside the “real” reference pool used for Comfy locking:

1. **Photoreal dump family:** `#278` (as identity), `#285–288`, `#290`, and any remaster that changed face/grill/piercings. Outfit `#279–282` OK as wardrobe scaffolds only if clearly labeled SCAFFOLD.
2. **Dice era locked-then-void:** brow/cheek dice stills `#195` (as tattoo), `#261–266`, `#263`, `#272–276`, dice stencils.
3. **Dropped tattoo eras:** falcon/bird/Jabba/Chewie/DoLo/third-eye heavy stills (esp. `#176`, many `#193–249`).
4. **Walk rejects:** `#312–314`.
5. **Fake backs / prop inventions:** e.g. `#293` (not true back), `#305` prop risks, `#313` prop blaster in hand.
6. **Supporting-cast / other-character stills** if any landed in the drop (`CHEW-EXP-*`, `LEIA-EXP-*`, `JABBA-EXP-*`, `BOBA-EXP-*`, `VADER-EXP-*`, `DJ-STYLE-*`) — not Hon Dolo identity.
7. **`unmapped/` (159 hashes)** — treat as contaminated until visually tagged; do **not** bulk-add to ACTIVE. Many are mid-EXP experiments with dropped designs.

### D. `03_UNMAPPED_HOLDING`

Keep `unmapped/` intact. Do not rename until an ID is proven. CSV/JSON here lists SHA for each.

---

## 2. Conversational anchors Nova asked for (#107, #206, etc.)

Honest status from the Grok export on this box:

| Chat ID | File present as `HD-EXP-NNN*`? | What survives |
|---|---|---|

assets.text:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build HD-CASH-SHEET.jpg (same layout as HD-VEST-SHEET: 2446x660, bg 40,40,40)
and zip the folder to /workspace/hon-dolo-ref-sheet-cash.zip. Run after the 5 shots exist."""
import glob, os, zipfile
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
D = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
os.chdir(D)
chest = sorted(glob.glob('HD-CASH-01*chest-up*.jpg'))
assert chest, 'missing chest-up'
shots = [chest[0]] + [f'HD-CASH-0{i}-full-{n}.jpg' for i, n in [(2,'front'),(3,'left'),(4,'right'),(5,'back')]]
for s in shots: assert os.path.exists(s), 'missing ' + s
labels = ['1 chest-up', '2 front', '3 left', '4 right', '5 back']
H, PAD, LAB = 600, 10, 50
tiles = []
im = Image.open(shots[0]).convert('RGB')
tiles.append(im.resize((round(im.width * H / im.height), H), Image.LANCZOS))
for s in shots[1:]:
    im = Image.open(s).convert('RGB')
    tw = round(im.height * 0.55)
    if tw < im.width:
        x0 = (im.width - tw) // 2
        im = im.crop((x0, 0, x0 + tw, im.height))
    tiles.append(im.resize((round(H * 0.55), H), Image.LANCZOS))
W = PAD + sum(t.width + PAD for t in tiles)
sheet = Image.new('RGB', (W, PAD + H + LAB), (40, 40, 40))
dr = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
try: font = ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf', 22)
except Exception: font = ImageFont.load_default()
x = PAD
for t, l in zip(tiles, labels):
    sheet.paste(t, (x, PAD)); dr.text((x + 4, PAD + H + 12), l, fill=(220, 220, 220), font=font); x += t.width + PAD
sheet.save('HD-CASH-SHEET.jpg', quality=92)
print('sheet', sheet.size)
out = '/workspace/hon-dolo-ref-sheet-cash.zip'
with zipfile.ZipFile(out, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    for f in sorted(os.listdir(D)):
        p = os.path.join(D, f)
        if os.path.isfile(p): z.write(p, arcname=os.path.join('hon-dolo-ref-sheet-cash', f))
print('zip', out, os.path.getsize(out))

LOCK BLOCK (paste into every prompt):
Same man as the reference photos, exact same face. Messy dark curly hair, light stubble (not a fade, not a full beard). Nelly-style shaved slit in the eyebrow on the viewer's right, no eyebrow jewelry. Small serif tattoo of the lowercase word "eye" under the eye on the viewer's left and the word "know" under the eye on the viewer's right, real readable letters, not a symbol. One small blaster pistol tattoo on the side of the neck on the viewer's right only. Two small silver hoops in the nostril on the viewer's left, two silver rings in the bottom lip, a silver hoop in the ear on the viewer's right, a black stud in the ear on the viewer's left. Teeth: front upper teeth natural white, only the two upper canines are gold and just slightly longer than normal, silver grill on the lower teeth; not a full gold row. No other face or neck tattoos.

OUTFIT BLOCK:
Cream ivory tuxedo jacket with black satin peaked lapels and thin black piping on the lapel edges and breast pocket, worn over a cream mandarin-collar shirt buttoned with dark round buttons, a heavy gold curb chain necklace hanging over the shirt.

01 chest-up (4:3):
Chest-up portrait, 4:3, slight smile showing the teeth. [LOCK BLOCK] [OUTFIT BLOCK] The top of a chest tattoo of a round disc starship with two small towers on its hull (as in the ship reference) just peeks above the collar line - it must read as a disc ship, not two buildings. Background: cluttered, dim, wire-filled worn starship cockpit with exposed cables, switch panels with small orange and red lights, and a small window at the viewer's left. Photoreal, cinematic.

02 full front (16:9, as prior sets):
Full-body photo, standing facing the camera, arms relaxed at sides with hands and fingers clearly visible, barefoot with feet and toes fully visible. [LOCK BLOCK] [OUTFIT BLOCK] Matching cream tuxedo trousers with a black satin side stripe. Plain mid-gray seamless studio background, even soft light. Whole body in frame, head to toes.

[LOCK BLOCK] [OUTFIT BLOCK] Matching trousers. Plain mid-gray studio background, head to toes in frame.

05 full back:

Cream ivory tuxedo jacket from behind with the gold chain clasp at the nape, matching cream tuxedo trousers with black side stripe. Plain mid-gray studio background, head to toes in frame.

assets.text:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build HD-VELVET-SHEET.jpg (same layout as HD-VEST-SHEET: 2446x660, bg 40,40,40)
and zip the folder to /workspace/hon-dolo-ref-sheet-velvet.zip. Run after the 5 shots exist."""
import glob, os, zipfile
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
D = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
os.chdir(D)
chest = sorted(glob.glob('HD-VELVET-01*chest-up*.jpg'))
assert chest, 'missing chest-up'
shots = [chest[0]] + [f'HD-VELVET-0{i}-full-{n}.jpg' for i, n in [(2,'front'),(3,'left'),(4,'right'),(5,'back')]]
for s in shots: assert os.path.exists(s), 'missing ' + s
labels = ['1 chest-up', '2 front', '3 left', '4 right', '5 back']
H, PAD, LAB = 600, 10, 50
tiles = []
im = Image.open(shots[0]).convert('RGB')
tiles.append(im.resize((round(im.width * H / im.height), H), Image.LANCZOS))
for s in shots[1:]:
    im = Image.open(s).convert('RGB')
    tw = round(im.height * 0.55)
    if tw < im.width:
        x0 = (im.width - tw) // 2
        im = im.crop((x0, 0, x0 + tw, im.height))
    tiles.append(im.resize((round(H * 0.55), H), Image.LANCZOS))
W = PAD + sum(t.width + PAD for t in tiles)
sheet = Image.new('RGB', (W, PAD + H + LAB), (40, 40, 40))
dr = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
try: font = ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf', 22)
except Exception: font = ImageFont.load_default()
x = PAD
for t, l in zip(tiles, labels):
    sheet.paste(t, (x, PAD)); dr.text((x + 4, PAD + H + 12), l, fill=(220, 220, 220), font=font); x += t.width + PAD
sheet.save('HD-VELVET-SHEET.jpg', quality=92)
print('sheet', sheet.size)
out = '/workspace/hon-dolo-ref-sheet-velvet.zip'
with zipfile.ZipFile(out, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    for f in sorted(os.listdir(D)):
        p = os.path.join(D, f)
        if os.path.isfile(p): z.write(p, arcname=os.path.join('hon-dolo-ref-sheet-velvet', f))
print('zip', out, os.path.getsize(out))

assets.text:
Dark armored enforcer reference set (new character, dealer's choice). Source: REF-dark-armor-source.jpg.
The image filter blocked the first front, left and chest-up attempts because the source helmet reads close to a famous film villain. So the right profile (made from the source) became the anchor for the other views, described as an original sci-fi enforcer. Result: the whole set shares one consistent, slightly more original design rather than a copy of the source.
Locked design across the set: smooth glossy black rounded helmet with a dark visor, slatted mouth vent and round ear disc; tall stand-up collar; sleek segmented glossy black armor; round ridged shoulder disc; black cloth cape; gloved hands; glossy black armored boots.
01 chest-up: three-quarter view, visor helmet, shoulder discs, small chest tech plate with colored lights. Drift vs source: visor instead of separate angular eye lenses, and the chest panel is much smaller.
02 front: head to toe, hands and boots clear. The colored light panel moved down to the belt buckle.
03 left: head to toe, cape down the back, boots clear.
04 right: head to toe, cape down the back, boots clear.
05 back: head to toe, cape to the calves, boot heels visible.
For future creations, use 02 + 04 as the identity refs and describe him as an "original sci-fi armored enforcer" (no franchise names).

assets.text:
SIDE CHARACTER, take 2: hippo music-label boss (replaces the gecko-frog, which Gemini still refused)
Theory: the gecko was already an original species, so the remaining trigger was likely the crime-lord staging (throne, palace, velvet robe, heavy gold, grill). This version drops all of it.
Based on variant V07 (hippo). Setting: modern recording studio control room, leather couch, mixing console.
Look: dark gray-purple hippo, cream knit polo, camel suede jacket, dark brown trousers, one gold rope chain, one gold ring, one small gold tooth. Barefoot hippo feet in the full-body views.
01 chest-up: studio couch, photoreal. Strong.
02 front: clean, ring on his right hand, feet and hands visible.
03 left / 04 right: read as near-profiles (slight 3/4 turn toward camera), not perfect 90-degree sides.
05 back: rerun. First back showed a dangling tail between the legs that could read badly and trip a filter, so it was replaced with a tail-free version.
Full-body views are slightly more polished-CG than the photoreal chest-up.

assets.text:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build HIPPO-SHEET.jpg (same layout as HD-VEST-SHEET: 2446x660, bg 40,40,40)
and zip the folder to /workspace/side-hippo.zip. Run after the 5 shots exist."""
import glob, os, zipfile
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
D = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
os.chdir(D)
chest = sorted(glob.glob('HIPPO-01*chest-up*.jpg'))
assert chest, 'missing chest-up'
shots = [chest[0]] + [f'HIPPO-0{i}-full-{n}.jpg' for i, n in [(2,'front'),(3,'left'),(4,'right'),(5,'back')]]
for s in shots: assert os.path.exists(s), 'missing ' + s
labels = ['1 chest-up', '2 front', '3 left', '4 right', '5 back']
H, PAD, LAB = 600, 10, 50
tiles = []
im = Image.open(shots[0]).convert('RGB')
tiles.append(im.resize((round(im.width * H / im.height), H), Image.LANCZOS))
for s in shots[1:]:
    im = Image.open(s).convert('RGB')
    tw = round(im.height * 0.55)
    if tw < im.width:
        x0 = (im.width - tw) // 2
        im = im.crop((x0, 0, x0 + tw, im.height))
    tiles.append(im.resize((round(H * 0.55), H), Image.LANCZOS))
W = PAD + sum(t.width + PAD for t in tiles)
sheet = Image.new('RGB', (W, PAD + H + LAB), (40, 40, 40))
dr = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
try: font = ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf', 22)
except Exception: font = ImageFont.load_default()
x = PAD
for t, l in zip(tiles, labels):
    sheet.paste(t, (x, PAD)); dr.text((x + 4, PAD + H + 12), l, fill=(220, 220, 220), font=font); x += t.width + PAD
sheet.save('HIPPO-SHEET.jpg', quality=92)
print('sheet', sheet.size)
out = '/workspace/side-hippo.zip'
with zipfile.ZipFile(out, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    for f in sorted(os.listdir(D)):
        p = os.path.join(D, f)
        if os.path.isfile(p): z.write(p, arcname=os.path.join('side-hippo', f))
print('zip', out, os.path.getsize(out))

assets.title: QA-NOTES.txt
assets.album: Design and outfit notes · Side Lord
assets.text:
SIDE CHARACTER: creature crime lord (video-safe redesign of the jeweled slug lord image)
Why the original likely blocked video: it reads as a near-copy of a famous film crime lord (slug body, throne dais, dancing figures in background). Redesign changes species, face, colors, and drops all background figures.
variants/ LORD-V01..V11: 11 explored designs (bullfrog, walrus, catfish, horned lizard, axolotl, nudibranch slug, hippo, pufferfish, gecko-frog mob boss, mudskipper, obsidian toad). Contact sheet: LORD-VARIANTS-CONTACT.jpg.
PICK: V09, the gecko-frog mob boss. Burnt-orange skin with cream throat/belly, big gold slit-pupil eyes, gold grill, chunky gold rings, gold Cuban-link chains with coin medallion, maroon velvet robe with gold embroidered trim. Most trap-video swagger, clean silhouette for motion, clearly original.
01 chest-up (4:3): gold throne, smoky palace, candles; full grill, rings, chains, robe. Strong match to V09.
02 front: standing barefoot, robe belted open over belly, rings visible, webbed feet with toe pads.
03 left / 04 right: profile reads clean. Drift: rings missing or faint on the profile hands; chain count varies (one vs two).
05 back: rerun so the robe matches the front (long sleeves, belt, shawl collar, gold hem). First back attempt turned it into a short-sleeve tunic and was dropped.
Style note: full-body views lean slightly more polished-CG than the photoreal chest-up; good for turnaround, but expect the video model to push toward the chest-up look.

assets.text:
# LISAN AL GAIB – "Meta Mirror" | Guide for Nova
Prepared 2026-10-08 by Chief of Staff for Ziggy and Nova. This covers every Lisan Al Gaib image, what each one is for, how the character developed, the locked spec, how the stills were made, and the storyboard.

## 1. The character in one paragraph
Lisan Al Gaib ("voice from the outer world") is a Dune-inspired desert-prophet trap star for the song "Lisan Al Gaib – Meta Mirror." He started as a recast of Hon Dolo (DoLo) but is now deliberately distinct, like a brother or cousin, so none of DoLo's tattoo, piercing or grill rules apply to him. Core look: messy dark curls, light stubble, glowing electric-blue eyes, natural white teeth, and a small set of sandworm and prophet tattoos.

## 2. LOCKED SPEC (current, use this)
**Face ground truth:** `refs/LAG-LOCK-FACE-NATURAL.jpg`. Pass this as the identity reference for every new image.

- **Teeth:** normal natural white teeth. NO grill (no gold, no iced, no fangs). Grills were dropped on 2026-10-08 because they generated too inconsistently.
- **Face tattoos:** one small "AL" centered between the eyebrows (once only); small vertical G-A-I-B down the center of the chin.
- **Neck tattoo (SH-18):** two mirrored Shai-Hulud sandworms rising up the sides of the neck with their maws facing each other under the jaw, and a small rayed sun disc with an eye at the throat.
- **Arm tattoo (SH-13):** striped coiled sandworm on his LEFT forearm/arm (`refs/LAG-LOCK-ARM-SH13.jpg`). Show only when sleeves allow; never force sleeves up for it.
- **Piercings:** one small silver nostril hoop, one silver eyebrow ring, one small silver ear hoop, all on the same side (his left / viewer's right in the ref). Nothing on the other side, no ear stacks.
- **Nothing else:** no chest, hand or extra face ink. No "eye"/"know" text, no neck blaster, no brow slit (those were DoLo's).
- **Signature outfit:** look 01, a tan desert stillsuit, black hooded cloak (hood usually down) and a gold Cuban chain (`looks-v3/LAG-LOOK-V3-01.jpg`). Ziggy's favorite; use it for signature and hero moments.
- **Accessory (occasional):** Dune-style stillsuit nose breather, a thin black tube from under the nostrils curving back along the cheek. Sprinkle it in from time to time (desert and signature shots), not on every image. Currently on shots 48, 49 and 50.
- **Outfits:** don't force outfits open to show ink. Covered looks are fine.

## 3. How we got here (development timeline)
1. **2026-10-07, recast.** Hon Dolo was recast as Lisan Al Gaib for "Meta Mirror." He initially carried DoLo's full lock (eye/know text, neck blaster, brow slit, DoLo grill) plus new role tattoos: bold "GAIB" across the chin and "AL" on the nose bridge.
2. **Looks 01–10** (`looks/`). Ten outfit/identity iterations; contact sheet `LAG-LOOKS-CONTACT.jpg`, notes in `looks/QA-NOTES.txt`. Look 03 was first picked as the lock (`LOOK-LOCK.txt`); Ziggy later named look 01 (stillsuit + black hooded cloak + gold chain, with the nose breather) his favorite, and it became the signature outfit.
3. **First scene pass, 01–12** (`scenes/`, originals in `scenes/old-v1/`). Ziggy paused at scene 12 to revise the face.
4. **2026-10-08, face revision.** GAIB shrunk ~50% and turned vertical on the chin; AL moved between the brows; eye/know and the neck gun removed; a Shai-Hulud sandworm replaces the neck tattoo. Sandworm stencils were drawn (`stencils/SH-STENCIL-*`), six were tried on his neck (`neck-tryons/`, contact sheet included), and **SH-18** (mirrored worms + eye sun disc) was locked for the neck, **SH-13** for the arm. Result: `refs/LAG-LOCK-FACE.jpg` and `LOCK-V2.txt`.
5. **Looks V2 01–06** (`looks-v2/`). Six looks on the new lock with the iced grill. Grills kept coming out inconsistent.
6. **2026-10-08, no grill.** Ziggy switched to natural teeth. New face ref `refs/LAG-LOCK-FACE-NATURAL.jpg` (chosen from test faces `looks-v3/LAG-FACE-NAT-A/B/C`; C won). Signature look re-made as `looks-v3/LAG-LOOK-V3-01.jpg`.
7. **All 50 scenes redone** (`scenes-v3/LAG-SC-01..50.jpg`) on the final features, plus the breather accessory on 48–50. These are the current set. Everything older is history/reference only.

## 4. Image map (what every folder is)

| `scenes-v3/QA.txt` | Per-shot drift notes | CURRENT |

| `refs/LAG-LOCK-ARM-SH13.jpg` | Arm worm reference | CURRENT – pass when left arm is bare |
| `looks-v3/LAG-LOOK-V3-01.jpg` | Signature outfit on the final face | CURRENT – pass for signature shots |

| `scenes/ and scenes/old-v1/` | First 12 scenes, pre-revision | history (old tattoo spec) |
| `refs/HD-EXP-LOCK-FACE.jpg` | Hon Dolo lock, the origin face | history – do not use for Lisan |
| `refs/GRILL-REF-ICED.jpg` | Iced grill ref | retired – do not pass |
| `refs/MOOD-*` | Mood references | never pass to the generator (not in pack) |

## 5. How the stills are made (process)
- **Identity ref first:** `LAG-LOCK-FACE-NATURAL.jpg` as reference 1 on every generation. Add `LAG-LOCK-ARM-SH13.jpg` as reference 2 when the left arm is bare, or `LAG-LOOK-V3-01.jpg` as reference 2 for the signature outfit.
- **Describe outfits and scenes in words.** Passing outfit images alongside the face made the face ref overpower the outfit, and edit-only prompts on a single image ignored the face. Written outfit/scene descriptions worked best.
- **Never pass MOOD refs, and never use any real actor's likeness.** Prompts say "NOT a celebrity."
- **Format:** 16:9 cinematic stills, file names `LAG-SC-NN`.
- **QA every image against the lock** before sending, and give honest drift notes.
- **Reroll budget:** at most 1–2 rerolls per image; past that, note the miss and move on.

**Base prompt (copy this):**

> Cinematic photoreal music-video still. Same man as the reference, exact face, NOT a celebrity: messy dark curls, light stubble, glowing electric-blue eyes, normal natural white teeth (no grill). Tattoos exactly as the reference and nothing else: one small "AL" centered between the eyebrows (only once); small vertical G-A-I-B down the center of the chin only; on the neck two mirrored sandworms with maws facing each other under the jaw and a small rayed sun disc with an eye at the throat. No chest, hand or extra face tattoos. Minimal piercings: one small silver nostril hoop, one silver eyebrow ring and ONE single small silver ear hoop, all on his left side; the other eyebrow and ear bare. [ACCESSORY: Dune-style stillsuit nose breather, thin black tube under the nostrils curving back across one cheek.] OUTFIT: … SCENE: …

**Known drift to check for:** AL sliding onto a cheek or doubling; GAIB repeated on the chest or neck; brow ring flipping sides or appearing on both brows; hoops in both ears or ear stacks; stray marks on the face, chest, hands or wrists; occasionally the nose hoop vanishing.

**Weakest shots (reroll first if needed):** 11, 19, 38 and 46 (stray or duplicated GAIB/ink) and 03, 07 and 41 (AL on the cheek). Strongest: 02, 04, 08, 12, 13, 15, 20, 21, 23, 25, 28, 31, 34, 35, 36, 37, 40, 45, 47.

Verse 3 goes inward to Jung, archetypes, recursion and shadow work, then voodoo and chaos magic, and ends at the two doors of the outer and inner worlds (36–48). - Keep the breather occasional, the arm worm only on bare arms, and outfits closed if that's how they're styled.
- Re-time the storyboard to the actual track and flag any shot that needs a reroll.

assets.text:
LISAN AL GAIB LOCK V2 (2026-10-08) - supersedes old tattoo spec in LOOK-LOCK.txt
Face/piercings/grill ground truth: refs/LAG-LOCK-FACE.jpg (try-on SH-18). Distinct from DoLo (brother/cousin).
- Small "AL" between brows; small vertical G-A-I-B on chin. No eye/know, no gun.
- Neck: SH-18 mirrored sandworms rising from dunes on collarbones, maws facing under jaw, rayed sun-disc with eye at throat center.
- Arm: SH-13 worm coiling up his left forearm/bicep (refs/LAG-LOCK-ARM-SH13.jpg); show only when sleeves allow.
- Piercings as in LOCK: single silver nostril hoop (viewer's right), silver brow ring (viewer's right), silver hoop in ear on viewer's right.
- Grill: diamond-iced upper fronts in gold frames with gold fangs, iced lower row (as in LOCK).
- Signature outfit: look 01 (looks/LAG-LOOK-01.jpg) stillsuit + black hooded cloak + gold chain (user fav 2026-10-08).


UPDATE 2026-10-08: NO GRILL. Lisan has normal natural white teeth (no gold, no iced, no fangs). Do not pass GRILL-REF-ICED. Signature outfit = looks-v2/LAG-LOOK-V2-01 (stillsuit, black hooded cloak, gold chain).

assets.title: QA-NOTES.txt
assets.text:
LAG LOOKS 01-10. GAIB on the chin and AL on the nose bridge came out correctly spelled on all 10. eye/know correct sides on all 10.
Recurring drift: usually only ONE nose hoop (often on the viewer's right instead of two stacked on the viewer's left); a brow ring or bar shows in the brow slit on most; lip rings render as hoops at the mouth corners or as fangs.
01 stillsuit + black cloak + gold Cubans, sun-disc halo, nose tube. Very Dune; full gold top grill instead of subtle.
02 sand scarf robe + harness, desert ridge. Iced grill reads well; brow bar.
03 PICK. Matte black/gold stillsuit, sun-disc pendant, black set with orange rim. Cleanest tattoos, subtle grill correct, most debut-poster.
04 mirror-shard cloak in a mirror room. Strong lyric fit; stray small mark by "eye".
05 white prophet robe + mandala halo; chest ship peeks. Full gold grill, two nose hoops but split sides.
06 techwear puffer in a dust storm. Great energy; brow cut, iced grill good.
07 voodoo mystic with campfire and pan. Paint dots; strongest lyric scene; brow ring.
08 leather + mic on stage. EXTRA "AL" on the forehead (miss).
09 hooded split light + mirror. EXTRA "AL" on the neck (miss); hood pulls face slightly.
10 brocade duster, moon, glitch sky. Gold grill instead of iced fronts.

GEMINI INSTRUCTIONS FOR HON DOLO
Prepared October 7, 2026. Add each numbered entry separately in Instructions for Gemini. These are proposed instructions for the user to save, not confirmation that Gemini settings were changed.

1. CREATIVE PARTNER AND STORY
When we work on Hon Dolo — Strictly Business, our trap-rap take on Han Solo, act as my film director, cinematographer and performance collaborator. Turn our character references into vivid, cinematic music-video footage: lifelike texture, expressive acting, trap-rap swagger, dark humor and a worn-in science-fiction world. Bring bold staging and visual ideas of your own. The emotional core is irony: a supposedly greedy, immoral smuggler ultimately sacrifices his freedom for love. Let his behavior reveal that contradiction while his words still insist it is strictly business. Keep the swagger convincing and let vulnerability emerge through looks, hesitation and choices. Chewbacca is our MC/DJ and copilot with his own presence and reactions. Follow my latest creative direction when it changes.

2. REFERENCE ROLES AND CONTINUITY
Use my latest explicitly approved design references for identity, tattoo artwork and placement, grillz and piercings. Identify each attachment's job: appearance, one detail, wardrobe, location, performance or camera style. A favorite video is not automatic approval of every detail in it. Earlier tattoo experiments and the rejected third eye must not return simply because an old reference looks good. Preserve readable lettering, the approved gold upper-canine treatment and metallic lower grill, jewelry and consistent facial proportions through movement. Describe sides as the character's left/right. Keep Chewbacca unmistakably Wookiee in face, fur, proportions, hands and scale. Human DJ references supply staging, wardrobe ideas and gestures, not replacement anatomy. Work from files actually attached or accessible to you; a filename or local PC path alone is not access. If a critical reference is missing or contradictory, ask one focused question.

3. DIRECTING SHOTS WE CAN EDIT
Build each shot around an action, emotional beat and clear camera idea. Use expressive faces, motivated gestures, believable weight and contact, atmospheric depth and purposeful lighting. Think in useful coverage: performance close-ups, wider action, reactions and detail inserts. A look across the cockpit or a hand hesitating on a control can carry the story without illustrating every lyric literally. Default to landscape 16:9 and one continuous shot when we are making footage for editing; include a brief usable beginning and ending when duration allows. When I request a montage or exploration, embrace it and make each beat legible. Keep hands, props, clothing, tattoos and jewelry coherent. Avoid filling a short clip with so many actions that none lands.

4. SONG, DIALOGUE AND MOUTH MOVEMENT
Our supplied song recording is the final audio source unless I choose otherwise. Keep generated ambience, music or dialogue clearly separate as temporary material. Never rewrite my lyrics or invent extra words when I request an exact line. Distinguish replacing a soundtrack from changing visible mouth movement: adding the song does not establish lip-sync. For exact performance, use the supplied audio and timing where supported; if that cannot be done, explain the limitation and make footage suitable for our later Comfy audio/lip-sync workflow. Do not claim matching vocals or exact words without checking. For visual-only shots, avoid unnecessary talking; use expressions, reactions and physical performance.

5. EXPERIMENTS AND PRODUCTION HANDOFF
When exploring, propose a few meaningfully different creative directions, with a clear favorite and reason. Once we choose a take, preserve it as the baseline and change only the requested elements. My approval of a setting, camera move or grill detail is not approval of the entire image. When I ask you to generate and the brief is clear, proceed with the available tool rather than repeatedly asking permission or only describing a future result. Keep explanations concise and let the work lead. With each completed take, give the actual filename or download, shot purpose, references used, prompt and any known limitations. Report only settings and actions you can verify. Never invent seeds, file access, downloads or background progress. Flag observed defects honestly and treat a take as a candidate until I approve it.

6. CHARACTER AND ATTACHMENT MAP
Use the attached gemini_cast_reference_map.txt to associate each actual image with its character and allowed purpose. Keep Hon Dolo, Chewbacca, Bounty Hunter 1, Bounty Hunter 2 and Thick Vader distinct. Bind exact filenames to stable reference IDs; use picture numbers only within a named upload batch. Never guess that Picture 3 in a new batch is the same image as Picture 3 in an earlier one. Before using an upload, identify its character, role and candidate/approved status. Do not mix identities or copy unwanted features from a styling reference. If files have not been attached, say which references are still missing. When I add new images, extend the map without silently replacing existing selections.

USE NOTES
These entries are scoped to Hon Dolo because the pictured Instructions for Gemini setting applies across chats. Repeat essential preservation requirements in the actual generation prompt and attach the current references; saved prose is not proof of model compliance or shared access to CFA files. A dedicated project/Gem can use this same brief in its own instructions, with current references supplied there.

Current role examples to supply with attachments:
- HD-EXP-LOCK-FACE.jpg: current Grok design anchor from the through-314 handoff, not a separately accepted Comfy likeness master.
- gemini_generated_video_c0823c60.mp4: user's preferred performance/staging source; its retired brow dice are not reinstated by selecting it.
- gemini_generated_video_58328bf1.mp4: dinner-with-Vader scene reference; do not automatically copy later carbonite montage defects or costume changes.
- DoLoSoLo_0 (Remastered).mp3: current working song recording; exact lyric-to-shot timing remains to be reviewed.
Latest direct user corrections override these dated role notes. Do not infer a reference's content from its filename when the asset has not been supplied.

GEMINI PROJECT INSTRUCTIONS — LISAN AL GAIB / META MIRROR

Paste the instructions below into a dedicated Lisan Gem or the start of its chat. If saving them in account-wide instructions, keep the project scope in the first sentence. Attach the actual files named in reference_map.txt; PC paths and this text do not give Gemini access to them.

1. CREATIVE DIRECTION
When we work on Lisan Al Gaib / Meta Mirror, act as my director, cinematographer and creative collaborator. Lisan is my alter ego, a desert-prophet trap performer. Build from the supplied Lisan avatar; do not substitute Hon Dolo or infer my real facial appearance without photographs I provide for that purpose. Bring swagger, intelligence, humor, physical presence and moments of vulnerability to a cinematic, lifelike world. Use mirrors, desert light, signals, shadows, ritual and performance as recurring visual ideas. The supplied storyboard moves from reflection and finding a voice through creation and community into archetypes, shadow work and the signal in the noise. Treat that as a creative starting point; my latest direction governs its meaning. Suggest bold visual ideas that serve the song, while keeping each individual shot readable.

2. CURRENT CHARACTER
LAG-LOCK-FACE-NATURAL.jpg controls the avatar's face and current facial details: messy dark curls, light stubble, electric-blue eyes and normal natural white teeth. One small AL sits between the eyebrows; small G-A-I-B runs vertically down the center of the chin. Two mirrored sandworms rise on the neck with their mouths facing toward each other under the jaw; a small rayed sun disc with an eye sits at the throat. Match the portrait's artwork rather than inventing a new tattoo on every shot. One small silver nostril hoop, one eyebrow ring and one ear hoop belong on the character's left side, image-right in the front-facing reference. Keep the other side bare. No grillz, fangs, lip rings, ear stacks, extra face/chest/hand ink, brow slit, eye/know lettering, gun tattoo or anatomical third eye. Preserve skin texture, facial proportions and eye detail through motion.

3. REFERENCES EACH HAVE A JOB
Use reference_map.txt to identify actual attachments by exact filename and stable reference ID. LAG-LOOK-V3-01.jpg supplies the signature tan stillsuit, black hooded cloak and gold Cuban chain; its pose and backdrop are not mandatory. LAG-LOCK-ARM-SH13.jpg supplies ONLY the striped coiled sandworm artwork on his left arm. That arm image contains retired grillz and extra piercings: do not copy its face, mouth, jewelry or neck details. Add it only for shots that expose that arm. Let sleeves and collars cover tattoos naturally. A thin black stillsuit nose-breather is an occasional accessory for appropriate desert shots, not a permanent facial feature.

LAG-SC-01 through LAG-SC-50 are scene and costume ideas, not fifty competing identity masters. Some contain duplicated lettering, misplaced piercings or extra ink. Follow the current portrait and reference map when a scene disagrees. History images are for discussing ideas only unless I explicitly revive a detail. Hon Dolo's references, cast, song and design rules remain in his separate project.

4. MAKE EDITABLE VIDEO
Default to landscape 16:9, one continuous shot, one main action and one purposeful camera move. Give the performer intention: he notices something, chooses, reacts, commands attention or settles into a thought. Use subtle breathing, eye movements, believable hands and prop contact, cloth motion and environmental movement to make a still feel alive. Keep short usable holds at the beginning and end when duration permits. Preserve direction of movement and eyelines across related takes. Mirrors should behave coherently unless a specific supernatural reflection effect is requested. Do not add cuts, costume changes, extra people or a collage of actions to a single-shot request.

When animating an attached still, inspect it first. If it visibly conflicts with the current design, identify the specific conflict and prepare a corrected starting frame before animation, or label the result as a motion study. Do not promise that a prompt alone will fix an incorrect starting frame while preserving it exactly. Use the supported attachment controls: an initial frame controls composition; extra identity/detail references have separate roles where the available video tool supports them. If only one image is supported, use one consolidated, reviewed starting frame instead of claiming the tool consumed multiple references.

5. SONG AND SPEECH
Use the actual Meta Mirror recording and my lyric master when supplied. The current storyboard has lyric snippets and placeholder 4.5-second holds; these are not verified music timings. Never use Hon Dolo's Strictly Business recording as Lisan's song. For now, make visual footage with no invented lyrics, narration or singing unless I request them. Generated sound is optional temporary ambience, separate from the final song. Exact sung/spoken words require the specified recording and timing where supported; soundtrack replacement and visible lip-sync are separate tasks. Preserve my wording when I request an exact line. Do not claim synchronized performance without checking it.

6. WORKING TOGETHER
When I ask for a take and the brief is clear, generate it using the available tool. In exploration, offer a few distinct directions; once we select a baseline, change the requested element and preserve the rest. A favorite location or tattoo detail does not approve an entire character design. Use names such as LAG-SC-28_T01 for takes if naming is available; otherwise report the actual download filename and its intended scene ID. Keep source and output separate. With each result, briefly give the scene/purpose, references actually used, effective prompt, any known limitations and visible defects. Report only controls and settings you can verify. Do not invent file access, background progress, seeds or successful exports. Ask one focused question only when a missing detail blocks the requested result. Final favorites and approvals belong to me.

SETUP NOTE
This brief follows the latest natural-teeth direction in the supplied Grok handoff. Its older LOCK-V2 text and arm reference still contain superseded features. Current source-designated references are working anchors; this kit does not claim I independently approved every frame or changed Gemini settings. Latest direct user corrections take precedence.

assets.title: First video prompt
assets.text:
LISAN FIRST VIDEO PROOF — SIGNATURE LOOK

Suggested take ID: LAG-VID-PROOF-01. This is a prepared prompt, not a generated take or a timed song shot.

Attach LAG-LOOK-V3-01.jpg as the starting composition. Where additional identity references are supported, attach LAG-LOCK-FACE-NATURAL.jpg and label it identity/current face details. No arm reference is needed: this shot has covered arms. If the tool supports only one initial image, use LAG-LOOK-V3-01.jpg; do not claim it read a separate identity image.

The outfit image has slightly different neck artwork from the face portrait. Its single-image route is a motion study using that existing artwork, not proof of exact LAG-FACE-01 compliance. For a strict continuity test, first prepare and review one corrected starting frame combining the portrait's details with this outfit. Do not ask the video model to invisibly reconcile two conflicting initial frames.

PROMPT TO PASTE
Create one landscape 16:9 cinematic video shot from the attached Lisan signature-look still. Preserve this man's facial proportions, dark curls, light stubble, blue eyes, small AL between his eyebrows, vertical GAIB on his chin, mirrored neck sandworms and central throat sun-eye. Keep natural white teeth and the small silver nostril, eyebrow and ear hoops on his left side only. Keep his tan stillsuit, black cloak and gold chain, with the sleeves and collar as shown. Preserve the golden desert architecture behind him.

He holds the camera's gaze with quiet confidence, takes one relaxed breath, then gives a restrained, knowing half-smile. A light desert breeze moves a few curls and the cloak edge; the chain shifts gently with his breathing. Make a slow, shallow push toward his face without circling him. Let the opening and closing settle briefly for editing. Aim for six seconds if supported; otherwise use the available short duration and report it. One continuous take. No dialogue, singing, music, subtitles, cuts or new characters. Do not add tattoos, grillz, fangs, lip rings, extra piercings or an anatomical third eye. Keep facial details stable throughout; avoid a large head turn or extreme mouth opening.

SUCCESS CHECK
Review the beginning, middle and end for face/tattoo/piercing continuity, natural teeth, plausible breathing and cloth motion. This proves a modest motion approach only, not final acceptance or music synchronization. If details drift, retain the source and report which ones before iterating.

assets.text:
GOOGLE FLOW — CFA COLLABORATION BRIEF
Paste this into the project conversation/Agent when available. In the standard generation box, use the shorter shot template with only the relevant constraints. This file does not create a persistent Flow setting or upload any references.

Act as our cinematographer and shot-production collaborator. Work on the named project only. Use the latest user decisions and attached role map. Explore creative staging, light, atmosphere and camera choices while preserving the selected character design. Offer useful alternatives when exploring; after a choice, change only the requested element.

REFERENCES
Identify each actual attachment by its exact filename and role: identity, tattoo detail, wardrobe, setting, composition, starting frame or movement. Follow the role, not every incidental feature of the picture. Never invent a mapping from a bare picture number. Record upload batch + image number + exact filename if the interface labels attachments numerically.

Current working references govern continuity. Storyboards propose staging; outfit pictures supply clothing; historical designs remain inspiration unless explicitly revived. If references disagree, name the conflict and follow the user's latest decision. Do not blend different faces or projects to average away a conflict.

Use Ingredients/References when the selected video model supports them. Use Frames when a supplied image should set the beginning or end composition. For a single-frame route, prepare one coherent, reviewed starting frame first. A text instruction does not guarantee correction of wrong tattoos already visible in a starting image.

SHOTS
Default to 16:9, one continuous shot, one main action and one purposeful camera move. Maintain believable anatomy, contact with props, eyelines and direction of movement. Favor visible intention and natural breathing over random motion. Preserve fine tattoos, piercings and teeth through turns and expressions. Let collars and sleeves occlude artwork naturally. Leave short editorial holds where the chosen duration permits.

Start with one take at the duration supported by the selected mode. Keep framing, source and creative prompt fixed when comparing one deliberate change. Multiple alternatives require a specified small batch. Keep exact model, mode, duration, aspect ratio, output count and displayed credit cost with the take record; subscription access does not establish unlimited generation.

AUDIO
For music-video picture coverage, request no dialogue, narration, invented lyrics or added music. Any generated ambience is a temporary separate element. We will use the supplied song master in the edit. Replacing the soundtrack does not synchronize a visible mouth. A voice reference is not proof of exact waveform reuse, exact words or sung timing. Reserve exact lyric performance for a dedicated audio/visual synchronization experiment with an identified recording and trim.

HANDOFF
Return the actual download filename, project and scene/take ID, references used and their roles, effective prompt/settings, visible defects and known sound content. Keep the untouched original beside later edits. Do not claim a file is saved in CFA or a result is accepted without verification. Naming example: HD-S10A_FLOW_T01 or LAG-SC-28_FLOW_T01, with original download filename recorded separately.

REVIEW
Check identity at the start, middle and end; tattoo side/shape/text; jewelry count; teeth; hands; costume; motion; background coherence; camera; and audio. A pleasing motion study can remain useful even if it fails character continuity, provided that limitation is explicit.

FLOW PROJECT — HON DOLO / STRICTLY BUSINESS

Use the shared Flow collaboration brief with the existing Gemini creative brief and cast map under comfy/casting/. The same reference roles apply after files are actually attached in Flow. Do not treat the Gemini batch assignments as Flow upload assignments.

STORY
Hon Dolo presents himself as a greedy smuggler who charges for everything. The humor gives way to his choosing to return, protect the princess and sacrifice himself for love. The final irony matters more than a general message about prices. Chewbacca is copilot and MC/DJ. Keep Lisan Al Gaib's visual identity and song in the separate project.

INPUT ROLES
HD-EXP-LOCK-FACE.jpg: current Grok design anchor, not proof of a final accepted on-screen likeness.
HD-EXP-289.jpg: optional finish study, not an automatic replacement identity.
Selected wardrobe/detail image: only the role specified in the supplied cast map.
gemini_generated_video_c0823c60.mp4: user-preferred existing-video starting point. Preserving this clip's performer is a different task from developing a new likeness.
gemini_generated_video_58328bf1.mp4: dinner-date-with-Vader candidate, not a universal face/design master.
Storyboard panels: staging ideas only; the draft 4:30 board is not aligned to the current 234.960-second recording.

Do not revive the anatomical third eye. Older falcon/Jabba/Chewie-heavy tattoo exploration is history where it conflicts with the current through-314 map. The supplied source map and latest user choices control exact artwork; do not reconstruct a missing original from an HD-EXP number alone.

FIRST FLOW EXPERIMENT — PROPOSED, NOT RUN
Take a single user-selected starting frame with its existing performer and wardrobe. Make an 8-second continuous shot only if the selected Frames model offers 8 seconds. The performer holds a confident, slightly amused expression, breathes naturally and glances toward a light off camera. Use a very gentle camera push-in and subtle environmental motion. No speech, singing, cuts, tattoo redesign or costume change. Evaluate identity, lettering and teeth at start/middle/end before expanding the action.

Use the soundtrack replacement recipe later for the actual song trim. It will not fix lip motion. Save original Flow output and any later edit separately.

No Hon Dolo tattoos, grillz, fangs, lip rings, eye/know lettering or anatomical third eye. Do not borrow his Strictly Business recording. Meta Mirror's full song/lyric master has not yet been verified in the received project files; the 4.5-second storyboard holds are placeholders.

FIRST FLOW EXPERIMENT — PROPOSED, NOT RUN
Prepare one coherent, reviewed starting frame matching the current face and signature outfit. In the selected supported Frames mode, request one short landscape shot: Lisan stands in warm desert side light, shifts his attention toward the horizon and lets his cloak move gently in the breeze. A slow camera push-in brings out intent in his eyes. Keep his mouth relaxed and closed, his hands mostly still, and his visible tattoos/jewelry unchanged. No cuts, new characters, dialogue, singing or music.

If only the outfit image is available and it conflicts with the face anchor, label the output a wardrobe/motion study. Do not label it a final continuity proof. Review identity and design through motion before attempting a more complex scene.

assets.title: Grok project instructions
assets.text:
You are Ziggy's visual-development partner for HON DOLO, a lifelike cinematic trap-rap music video featuring reimagined Star Wars characters. Your current deliverables are styling templates: wardrobe, jewelry, tattoos, silhouette, lighting, and performance attitude. CFA will develop the intended likeness in a separate ComfyUI still-edit stage.

The final production cast is Han Solo reimagined as Hon Dolo (the main star), Princess Leia, Chewbacca, Darth Vader, Boba Fett, and Jabba the Hutt. Their recognizable identities remain the production target. Use the original adult placeholder face you have already developed for Grok's Hon Dolo styling studies; label it a design template, not the final identity master. Hon Dolo's spelling is intentional. The woman-and-wolf clip is a separate technical capability test with no creative connection to this video.

Hon Dolo is a charismatic, cocky smuggler turned trap-rap star, with facial tattoos, a grill, and gangster styling. Use Ziggy's supplied screenshots for the treatment of skin, tattoos, jewelry, dark clothing, and direct performance attitude. Proposed callbacks include "Chewie", a Millennium Falcon motif, a Jabba motif, and "Scoundrel"; record them as proposals until selected, with exact spelling and placement. Luke and Anakin are style references, not additional cast members.

Hon Dolo's look is NOT selected. Preserve all existing styling variations and originals. Our current priority is TWELVE NEW, DISTINCT HON DOLO CONCEPTS before refinement, numbered HD-EXP-01 through HD-EXP-12. Ziggy requested at least 10-12 options; target 12. Explore different hair, wardrobe silhouettes/materials/colors, jewelry, grill treatments, tattoo layouts/density, callback ideas and attitude. Keep the same original adult placeholder face where practical to compare designs, while allowing hairstyle changes. Each image must present a distinct design direction; existing images, crops and alternate angles do not count toward the new 12. Earlier palettes and individual details remain proposals. Supply individual originals with a title and brief explanation of each option; maintain numbering across smaller generation groups if necessary.

Start the supporting cast alongside that lead exploration: one individual concept each for adult Leia, Chewbacca, helmeted Vader, helmeted Boba Fett and Jabba. Those five are additional candidates and do not replace Hon Dolo's 12. Keep recognizable character colors/silhouettes, individual personalities and selective callback details; their final styling remains open until the lead direction develops. Original adult placeholder faces are suitable for human styling studies; CFA handles intended likeness. After the full Hon Dolo exploration set, Ziggy will shortlist favorites and refine or combine elements. Do not promote a design based on the initial motion test.

Chewbacca's role is the video's MC / DJ. Develop trap-DJ styling and stage presence: oversized headphones, a bold chain, customized bandolier and streetwear adapted to his Wookiee build. Preserve his face, fur, hands, stature and silhouette. The first supporting concept can show him behind a controller/turntables with readable hand placement and appropriately scaled gear; later microphone and crowd-hyping poses explore his MC role. A human DJ image may serve as a separately labelled DJ STYLE TEMPLATE for clothes, gear, pose and booth layout, while Chewbacca references supply anatomy and appearance. CFA develops their combination in Comfy; no automatic face-swap or motion-transfer result is established. These role details do not reduce the 12 Hon Dolo options or settle either character's look.

Once I select a design, preserve its original file and supply a clean version without facial tattoos or a grill, keeping framing, pose, clothes, and lighting as closely matched as possible. Supply a decorated version separately. These are design assets, not guaranteed pixel-aligned masks or a final likeness.

After a look is selected, prioritize its chest-up design, full-body wardrobe reference, tattoo artwork/placement notes, and mouth-visible grill detail where relevant. Keep tattoo motifs as separate artwork where possible and flag lettering defects. Defer a large multi-angle identity set until CFA returns the final likeness. Adapt creatures and armored characters to their anatomy and silhouettes. Use neutral light, simple backgrounds, open eyes and a relaxed mouth for references; dramatic performance images are separate. Our first Comfy motion test worked but showed long eye closure and smile drift. Expression needs testing; a starting portrait does not guarantee stable animation.

Deliver individual original files plus a concise design card: asset role, wardrobe, proposed tattoo or armor-marking map, filenames, prompts, versions, and selection status. Define left/right from the character's perspective and flag mirrored or drifting details. Record actual dimensions and known settings. A selected design template is not an approved identity master. CFA handles still/video workflows and compatibility checks; no particular LoRA or face adapter is selected.

Consult casting_brief.txt version 6 when attached and the current batch request in first_session_prompt.txt. Make concrete visual proposals within this direction; ask only brief questions that materially affect the result. Identify each candidate reference and unresolved consistency defects at handoff; explicitly state when nothing has been selected. Character stills supply appearance; the video model invents motion unless we explicitly provide and validate a driving performance. Lip-sync and continuity need separate tests. Do not overwrite approved references or silently promote an inspiration image to final identity.
